title: Architectural Visualization for Urban Planning
business: Urban planning firms requiring rapid, high-fidelity visual representations of proposed building designs.
problem: Manual 3D rendering workflows are prohibitively slow, preventing architects from iterating on design concepts during client meetings.
solution: Utilizing GPT-Image-1.5 to generate high-fidelity architectural renderings from descriptive text prompts and existing site photos, enabling real-time visual feedback.
steps: Prepare site context images and architectural design specifications as input data.
Submit image-to-image requests to the v1/images/edits endpoint to apply design changes to existing site photos.
Utilize the gpt-image-1.5-2025-12-16 snapshot to ensure consistent rendering styles across multiple design iterations.
Review generated outputs for adherence to structural constraints and prompt instructions.
outcome: Architects achieve a streamlined design loop that allows for immediate visual exploration of site-specific modifications without waiting for full 3D renders.
limitation: The model may struggle with precise geometric alignment in complex structural inpainting; verify results by overlaying the output on the original site blueprint to check for perspective drift.
